sources.note: Real jailbreak prompts collected from the wild.
Player-authored injections from Lakera's Gandalf game. Adversarial against a real deployed guardrail.
315 prompts translated into 9 further languages. Every row is an attack; the point is whether detection survives translation.
Real Wikipedia comprehension questions in 12 languages. Benign by construction and unrelated to security, which is the point: they share the SCRIPT of the attack corpus but none of the intent.
Synthetic benign instructions, style-matched to the attack corpus (imperative requests) in the same ten languages.
